claim_summary: AgriWorld contributes an agricultural temporal-data environment, an execution-feedback agent, temporal alignment, and a checker-based benchmark for tool-grounded reasoning.

claim_evidence.quote: AGRI W ORLD: an executable agricultural environment. We introduce a Python environment that unifies geospatial querying, remote-sensing time-series analytics, crop simulation, and task-specific predictors through consistent APIs, enabling grounded and auditable agronomic analyses.

AGRO -R EFLECTIVE: an execution-driven reflective agent. We propose a multi-turn agent that iterates execute–observe–refine, using intermediate artifacts to self-correct and produce tool-grounded analysis traces rather than one-shot text.

modules.name: Canonical spatiotemporal alignment
modules.scope_reason: R3_2_GTS: yes, the operator reprojects spatial data and aligns temporal data to a canonical frequency; under the R3_1_TSK counterfactual, these remain temporal-data operations across tasks rather than a task-specific objective.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - alignment is not bound to one task criterion

evidence.quote: We define a composite alignment operator Π that maps arbitrary inputs to a unified working space:

Sreproject transforms vector/raster geometries to a task-specific CRS (e.g., EPSG:3857 for metric calculation), and Tresample aligns temporal data to a canonical frequency (e.g., daily) using strictly defined interpolation policies (nearest/linear)[65].

modules.name: Execute-observe-refine code loop
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK: no, feedback-driven code repair is not bound to one task family; R3_2_GTS: no, the loop manages execution and diagnostics without itself requiring temporal windows or order; R3_3_GH: yes, it controls execution and state.
rubric_path: R3_2_GTS:no - temporal semantics belong to tools/checkers, not loop

modules.name: Executable agricultural evaluation suite
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK: yes, generated instances embed task-specific schemas and executable checkers; changing task family changes the output and validation procedure. The suite is an evaluation resource, not a general temporal runtime (GTS no).

evidence.quote: To evaluate such agents systematically, we build a verifiable evaluation suite on top of an existing agricultural benchmark by converting questions into tool-grounded instances with deterministic reference code and executable checker functions.

A verifiable evaluation suite with executable checkers. Built on top of an existing benchmark, we provide a scalable task generation and scoring pipeline with deterministic reference programs and executable checkers spanning lookups, forecasting, anomaly detection, and counterfactual interventions
